business_scope.primary_industry_name: Real Estate Property Management and Rental Screening Cloud

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-2, L.561-2-1, L.561-45 through L.561-50 and R.561-1 through R.561-17 of the Code monétaire et financier; Décret n° 2020-118 du 12 février 2020 on AML/CFT implementing measures; Décret n° 2018-284 du 18 avril 2018 on the declaration of beneficial owners; INPI guide for the Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized or certified copy of passport or national identity card of each individual UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country public notary or competent national registry

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, register extract and current officers list of any corporate UBO above 25% ownership
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registrar or chamber of commerce in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney for the authorized representative executing the SAS incorporation file
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country notary or French consular authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of registered address or utility bill evidencing physical presence for each UBO, where addressed outside France
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local government authority or public utility provider

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors, statutory representatives and authorized signatories against: the French national PEP file implementing Article R.561-16 of the Code monétaire et financier; EU consolidated financial sanctions and EU terrorist list; United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions; TRACFIN typologies; and, where U.S.-nexus exists or USD payment rails are planned, the OFAC SDN list. Enhanced due diligence is required where a UBO is a PEP, is domiciled in a high-risk third country, the shareholding is held through opaque intermediary entities, or any adverse media/legal-source hit is identified.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique électronique des formalités d'entreprises (INPI) at https://guichet-entreprises.inpi.fr, supplemented by the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) search facility at https://data.inpi.fr and commercial court register extracts via Infogreffe.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name and all statutory documents must be written in French. The name must be in Latin script, transliterated if originating from a non-Latin alphabet, and must not consist only of generic product words. A distinctive or fanciful element is required to avoid confusion with pre-existing French corporate names and trademarks.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name or registration refusal by the INPI Guichet unique or the RCS registrar, the applicant must first file a written reconsideration request (recours gracieux) in French within one month, attaching evidence of identity, prior-use documentation, an RNE/INPI search report and, if applicable, the prior right holder's written consent. If reconsideration is unsuccessful, the applicant may, within 15 days, file summary proceedings before the President of the competent Tribunal de Commerce (référé) under Article L.123-5-1 of the Code de commerce to order the registrar to accept the filing. Parallel opposition or cancellation proceedings under the Code de la propriété intellectuelle are available where the refusal is based on an earlier trademark. The applicant may also submit an alternative name through the Guichet unique at any time.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted. A SAS may use a licensed commercial domiciliation service under Article L.123-11-2 of the Code de commerce, provided the address is a real place for receipt of legal correspondence and the service includes retention of statutory records. A virtual office is acceptable for a PropTech SaaS company because no sector-specific mandatory physical premises apply, but the address must not be a mere letterbox and any mailbox-service provider must be registered with the INPI/RNE.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; estimated 7% probability of an unannounced inspection within the first 24 months for a low-risk, non-regulated SaaS company with EEA-resident UBOs. Likelihood rises to approximately 35% if the UBO profile contains non-EEA high-risk jurisdictions, the domiciliation address is shared by many corporate objects, or administrative inconsistencies appear in the RBE declaration.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registrar registration tax for RCS creation (droit de greffe)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed by the French Ministry of Justice

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal publication in an authorized Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) of the notice of incorporation of the SAS
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Authorized legal gazette publisher in the chosen judicial Département
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulated maximum tariff per insertion, varying by département

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration and AML/CFT file assembly, PEP/OFAC/UN screening, and RBE submission assistance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External avocat or appointed compliance provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Flat professional fee at prevailing market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and commercial registry / trademark comparison report
12-month registered office domiciliation contract with virtual-office services
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of approximately USD 20 per month

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille and consular legalization of non-French UBO identification documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-country notary, apostille authority and, if needed, French consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official foreign statutory fees plus courier handling; no fixed French tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: French-language legal review of the SAS articles of association and GDPR/property-data risk note
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market hourly or fixed fee for 3–4 hours of expert review

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Electronic countersignature, courier and bank signature-verification support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for administrative handling costs

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, Articles L. 227-1 to L. 227-20 (Société par Actions Simplifiée); general company-formation provisions in Articles L. 210-1 et seq. and R. 210-1 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The competent Registry of the Commercial Court (Greffe du tribunal de commerce), following filing through the INPI-operated Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises; registration is in the Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic company-formation formalité submitted through the Guichet unique, including the signed articles of association (statuts) and required declarations and supporting documents; there is no separate statutory incorporation certificate to file.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital applies to an SAS; capital may be set at EUR 1. At least 50% of cash contributions must be paid at incorporation, with the balance payable within five years of RCS registration. Cash contributions must be deposited before filing with an authorized bank, notary, or the Caisse des dépôts et consignations; deposited funds are released after proof of registration. Contributions in kind are generally fully contributed at formation and may require a contribution auditor, subject to statutory exemptions.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company accepts the subscriptions for the shares set out in the executed articles of association, and that the President is authorized to complete any related issuance and subscription records. RESOLVED, that the Company’s registered office shall be at [full address in France], effective upon registration, and that the President may execute the required occupancy or domiciliation documents. RESOLVED, that [name] is appointed President and [name, if applicable] is appointed Director General, each to serve under the articles of association and applicable law. RESOLVED, that the President is authorized to submit the incorporation filing and take all related actions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Approve the SAS articles and appoint its officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders and the Company; no government filing window applies at this internal step.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the articles in French, specifying the company name, purpose, registered office, term, share capital, contributions, governance rules, and appointment method for the President. Have all founders sign the final version; use qualified electronic signatures or wet-ink signatures. Notarization is not generally required. Obtain any required sworn translations and properly authenticated foreign corporate documents where a founder is a legal entity.
required_dossiers: Final articles of association signed by all founders
Founder identity and address details, or corporate documents and representative authority for legal-entity founders
President's identity, address, and signed acceptance of office
Director General details and acceptance, if appointed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct inconsistent or incomplete articles, obtain missing signatures or authority evidence, and re-execute corrected documents before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized bank, notary, or Caisse des dépôts et consignations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transfer the cash subscription amount due at formation to the depositary account and obtain the certificate of deposit (certificat du dépositaire des fonds). At least half of subscribed cash contributions must be paid at formation. Keep the funds blocked until the depositary receives evidence of RCS registration.
required_dossiers: Signed articles or draft articles accepted by the depositary
Founder and beneficial-owner identification documents
Share subscription and payment details
Certificate of deposit of funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resolve identity, source-of-funds, or document queries with the depositary; amend the subscription details if necessary and obtain a corrected deposit certificate before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Secure and evidence the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises (INPI) for the subsequent filing; the office provider, landlord, or host supplies the occupancy evidence.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select a lawful French registered-office address and obtain evidence of the right to use it. For a domiciliation company, use its contract; for leased premises, provide the lease or occupancy evidence; for a hosted office, provide the host's authorization and address evidence. No general notarization is required.
required_dossiers: Lease, domiciliation agreement, or host authorization
Recent proof of address for the premises or domiciliation provider
Evidence of the President's authority where the registered office is at the President's residence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Replace deficient address evidence or obtain written landlord or host consent; amend the articles if the registered-office address changes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit the incorporation formalité and beneficial-owner declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises, with review and RCS registration by the competent Greffe du tribunal de commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the company-creation formalité electronically through the Guichet unique. Upload the signed articles, deposit certificate, registered-office evidence, officer declarations, and other required supporting documents. Declare the beneficial owners through the applicable filing process, pay the displayed registry and beneficial-owner charges, and retain the submission receipt. Documents not in French may require a French translation; foreign public documents may require apostille or legalization where applicable.
required_dossiers: Signed articles of association
Certificate of deposit of cash funds
Registered-office evidence
President and, if applicable, Director General identity and non-conviction declarations
Beneficial-owner information
Notice of formation published in an authorized legal announcements medium, with publication certificate
Founder corporate documents and powers of attorney, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the Guichet unique or registry request within the stated deadline, upload corrected or missing documents, and pay any additional fee. If rejected, correct the specified defect and resubmit; seek registry clarification or use the applicable appeal procedure for a disputed refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain registration evidence and release capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce and the capital depositary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After acceptance, obtain the RCS registration evidence and SIREN/SIRET identifiers, then provide proof of registration to the depositary to release the blocked funds. Preserve the final articles, filing receipt, registration evidence, beneficial-owner filing evidence, and corporate registers.
required_dossiers: RCS registration evidence or Kbis extract
Deposit certificate and depositary release instructions
Final filed articles and filing receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration evidence is delayed or contains an error, contact the competent registry through the filing channel and request correction; provide corrected registration evidence to the depositary.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board or manufacturing authority is ordinarily competent for the stated software-as-a-service activity. The INPI Guichet unique handles business formalities; the activity is not identified as a regulated profession or licensed industrial operation on the stated facts.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific operating or manufacturing permit is ordinarily required for real-estate property-management and rental-screening software services. Separate authorization may apply if the company itself performs regulated real-estate agency, property-management, payment, or other regulated activities.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition (Ministère de la Transition écologique); regional environmental services may be involved where a specific regulated installation is proposed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not ordinarily applicable to a software-service company without a project or installation listed under the French environmental assessment or ICPE regimes.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No activity-specific wastewater, VOC, or industrial-waste thresholds ordinarily apply to the stated SaaS activity. Any premises must comply with generally applicable building, waste, and public-health rules; regulated installations or discharges require separate assessment and permits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No manufacturing-site clearance is ordinarily required for the stated activity. Office premises remain subject to applicable building and fire-safety requirements, including rules for establishments open to the public where applicable, and to French occupational health and safety obligations. Additional fire, structural, or environmental approvals depend on the premises, building use, and any regulated installation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the official portal impots.gouv.fr; VAT registration and taxpayer identification are administered by the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) and the DGFiP central registry.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing or contracting with a French SAS must first secure a French SIREN/SIRET registration through the formalités entreprises.gouv.fr portal. For VAT, a Form CA20 must be filed with the competent SIE, after which the intra-Community VAT number (TVA intracommunautaire) is issued for EU-established operators. Non-EU-established suppliers may register through the non-EU OSS portal or by designating a statutory fiscal representative. The SIREN number is the national tax identification number (TIN) for fiscal correspondence and e-invoicing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in French law. An SAS is mandatorily subject to corporate income tax (IS) under Article 206 of the Code Général des Impôts (CGI); it cannot elect pass-through status. Permitted elections include: (i) fiscal integration (intégration fiscale) under Article 223 A CGI for a French parent holding at least 95% of eligible French subsidiaries; (ii) for certain leases, an option for VAT under Article 261 D CGI; (iii) elected territoriality choices in line with Article 209 I CGI concerning profits of foreign permanent establishments; and (iv) for hybrid mismatch purposes, no elective reclassification is permitted—ATAD anti-hybrid rules under Articles 205 and 212 bis CGI prescribe mandatory asymmetry adjustments rather than taxpayer elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 85,000 for principal goods suppliers and EUR 34,400 for service providers under the franchise en base rules; however, non-established foreign suppliers and OSS distance sales have no domestic local threshold and must register from the first euro. For intra-EU OSS distance sales to non-taxable persons, an EU-wide EUR 10,000 threshold applies. PropTech SaaS digital services are taxed at the customer's place of establishment.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France mandates phased e-invoicing for domestic B2B transactions and e-reporting for B2C transactions. From 1 September 2026, large and mid-sized businesses must issue and receive structured electronic invoices (Factur-X/UBL/CII) through certified Plateformes de Dématérialisation Partenaires (PDP) or the Portail Public de Facturation (Chorus Pro); from 1 September 2027 the obligation extends to small and micro businesses. Invoice data must be transmitted to the DGFiP within one business day of issuance. Digital audit file (Fichier des Écritures Comptables) obligations continue to apply.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (exonération avec droit à déduction) is available for goods physically exported to a destination outside the EU under Article 262 CGI, subject to proof of transit via Customs Export Declaration. For PropTech SaaS services, zero-rating applies when the recipient is a business established outside the EU under Article 259 A CGI, or when the recipient is a non-EU final consumer receiving digitally supplied services under Articles 259 D and 283-2 CGI. Intra-EU B2B supplies qualify for the zero-rated intra-Community reverse charge under Article 262 ter (iv) CGI provided the customer supplies a valid VAT number and the service is not otherwise taxable at a fixed establishment in France.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en Douane / DAU) or Déclaration d'Échange de Biens (DEB) for physical exports
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill or other transport evidence proving the goods left the EU
Inward Remittance Certificate or equivalent bank/FX proof of payment repatriation for the exported goods or services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP audits export zero-rating claims with full documentation substantiation. If the export or offshore service is found fraudulent or unsubstantiated, the VAT improperly zero-rated is clawed back with penalty interest at 4% per month. Under Articles 1789 and 1790 CGI, a bad-faith assessable penalty of 40% applies; where the taxpayer deliberately concealed incomplete documentation, the penalty rises to 80%. Criminal fraud under Article 1741 CGI carries up to five years' imprisonment and a €75,000 fine (for a legal entity, up to €375,000 or five times the statutory individual fine). Customs code penalties for false declarations can also include confiscation of the underlying goods and fines up to ten times the value of the goods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France is France's central bank and participates in the Eurosystem. The French Treasury (Direction générale du Trésor) administers relevant financial and monetary rules; the Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution (ACPR) supervises banks and payment institutions within its remit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France uses the euro and applies EU free-movement-of-capital rules. There are no general exchange controls or routine prior approvals for lawful current-account or capital-account payments, including ordinary cross-border investment, dividends, service fees, or loan payments. Banks must apply AML/CFT, sanctions, customer-due-diligence, and transaction-monitoring requirements. Dividend and other profit remittances remain subject to corporate-law distribution rules, available distributable profits, tax withholding where applicable, and documentation requested by the intermediary. Payments involving sanctioned parties, restricted jurisdictions, or regulated financial activities may be prohibited or require authorization.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no general statutory deadline requiring export proceeds to be repatriated and no mandatory foreign-currency conversion or surrender ratio. Export receipts may generally be retained in foreign currency or in an eligible foreign account, subject to bank terms, AML/CFT and sanctions controls, applicable tax and accounting rules, and any statistical or reporting obligations applicable to the transaction. Cash or bearer negotiable instruments of EUR 10,000 or more crossing the EU external border must be declared under applicable EU and French rules.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account; temporary share-capital deposit account may be available during incorporation
Operational Account; temporary share-capital deposit account may be available during incorporation
Operational Account; temporary share-capital deposit account may be available during incorporation
Operational Account; temporary share-capital deposit account may be available during incorporation

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium to high for routine collections and payments where the provider is authorized in France or passported under applicable EU rules. An electronic money institution is not a deposit-taking bank; safeguarded e-money is not equivalent to a bank deposit and may not carry deposit-guarantee protection. Confirm the provider's authorization, permitted services, client-fund safeguarding, French or SEPA IBAN availability, settlement limits, chargeback terms, and support for corporate capital-account requirements. Do not assume an offshore EMI account will be accepted for incorporation capital deposits or all banking counterparties.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law does not generally require directors to attend a bank branch in person to open a corporate account. Banks set their own risk-based onboarding procedures and may require a live video or in-person interview, certified documents, local contact details, or a visit where ownership, source of funds, or business activity cannot be verified remotely. Remote onboarding is possible but not guaranteed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial ownership, nominee arrangements, or ownership through multiple foreign entities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current articles and registration extract; complete ownership chart to natural-person ultimate beneficial owners; shareholder register; identity and address evidence for directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners; beneficial-owner filing evidence where applicable; certified translations or legalization where requested.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital contribution or operating funds inconsistent with the company's profile or unexplained source of wealth
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share-subscription documents; bank statements tracing funds to the remitter; source-of-funds and, where proportionate, source-of-wealth evidence; investor or shareholder financial records; board resolutions; loan agreements or investment agreements; tax and sale documents supporting material proceeds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PropTech platform activity appears to involve rent collection, tenant deposits, escrow, payment services, or handling third-party funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed funds-flow diagram; customer and counterparty descriptions; platform terms; invoices and sample contracts; explanation of whether the company ever controls or holds client money; payment-provider agreements; safeguarding and segregation controls; legal analysis of any payment-services or real-estate regulatory perimeter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume international transfers, payments to unrelated third parties, or activity inconsistent with a French SaaS business
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business plan and forecast; customer and supplier contracts; invoices; service-delivery evidence; expected countries, currencies, counterparties, and transaction values; reconciliation and approval controls; explanation of payment purpose and commercial rationale.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions exposure, high-risk-country connections, or politically exposed persons among owners or counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Screening results and risk assessment; identities and roles of relevant persons; contracts and transaction rationale; beneficial-ownership evidence; enhanced due-diligence materials; documented escalation and approval records. Do not process prohibited transactions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Receive shareholder or investor funds into the SAS's corporate account or, during formation, the bank or notary capital-deposit account accepted for incorporation. Use a clearly identified remitter and payment narrative such as share-capital subscription, share premium, or shareholder loan, consistent with the executed documents; France does not impose a universal statutory FX purpose-code system for ordinary commercial wires. Retain subscription or loan documents, board approvals, remitter bank evidence, and the funds trail. Reconcile capital receipts to the share register, accounting records, and applicable corporate filings. For non-euro receipts, agree conversion and fees with the bank and preserve the original currency and conversion records.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for eligible euro payments within the SEPA scheme; use SWIFT cross-border transfers, commonly evidenced by an MT103 message, for non-SEPA or foreign-currency payments. Commercial documentary credits, including letters of credit, may be arranged through a bank subject to credit approval and applicable ICC rules. Support payments with supplier contracts, invoices, delivery or service evidence, tax records, and approval controls. Apply sanctions screening, beneficiary verification, fraud controls, and reconciliation. A bank may request additional information or hold a payment under its AML/CFT obligations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards for documented commercial exposures, subject to counterparty onboarding and applicable conduct requirements
Non-deliverable forwards where commercially appropriate and legally available for the relevant currency pair
Currency swaps and cross-currency swaps for documented liquidity or balance-sheet exposures
Spot foreign-exchange transactions for operational conversions
Options or other derivatives only where appropriate to the company's risk-management policy and subject to applicable MiFID II, EMIR, reporting, clearing, collateral, and counterparty requirements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements deposit (dépôt des comptes annuels) with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of shareholder approval and in any event within 7 months of fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SAS, deposit by 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court-ordered penalty up to EUR 1,500 and potential daily fine (astreinte) up to EUR 10 per day; inability to receive state subsidies or funding until regularised.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale, form 2065-SD et annexes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year fiscal year, due by the second business day after 1 May (practically 3 May for online filers under Article 53A CGI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of tax due, plus 0.5% monthly late interest; possible automatic 100% penalty for omitted tax base in cases of misuse.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual local business tax return and payment (contribution foncière des entreprises, form 1329-SD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Declared and paid annually by 15 June for existing companies; reduced first-year charge for new businesses
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of assessed amount, increased to 40% where the return is not submitted within 30 days of a formal notice; plus late payment interest at 0.20% per month.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner declaration surveillance and annual consistency confirmation (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: INPI / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (via Guichet Unique)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Standing obligation to update within 30 days of any change; annual verification performed at the time of the annual accounts filing to confirm the registered data remains accurate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to EUR 7,500 for legal entities and EUR 1,500 for natural persons; potential exclusion from public contracts and administrative strike-off in serious recurring cases.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory audit (commissaire aux comptes) for a SAS when at least two of the following three thresholds are exceeded at year-end: total balance sheet EUR 4,000,000; net turnover EUR 8,000,000; average workforce of 50 permanent employees. Audit exemption applies for small companies above thresholds only until the second consecutive year of exceedance.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP pursuant to the Plan Comptable Général (ANC regulations), mandatory for individual financial statements; IFRS as adopted by the EU is permitted for consolidated financial statements of certain qualifying entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation is performed in conjunction with the annual accounts filing: the company must verify that the identity details of beneficial owners registered with the RCS are current and complete. Any shareholding transfer or change in control must be formally filed via the Guichet Unique within 30 days of the event, accompanied by a revised declaration of beneficial owners.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (registre des actions et des transferts)
Register of Directors (registre des décisions et de présence des associés)
Register of Security Interests and Pledges (registre des nantissements)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – 1,200 per annum for commercial registered address and corporate agent services in Paris and major French cities
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 – 10,000 per audit engagement for a small-to-mid-sized PropTech SAS

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced rate of 15% on the first €42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying SMEs (Article 219-I-c CGI: annual turnover below €10,000,000, capital fully paid up and held directly or indirectly at least 75% by individuals or by companies satisfying the same conditions); Research Tax Credit (CIR) of 30% on qualifying R&D and software-prototype expenses up to €100,000,000, falling to 5% on the excess; Young Innovative Company (JEI) profit exemption for the first two profitable fiscal years within an annual €100,000 cap; participation exemption (régime mère-fille) leaving only 5% of received subsidiary dividends within the taxable base; 10% reduced corporate income tax rate on qualifying patent and closely linked copyrighted software licensing income under Article 238 CGI, subject to the OECD nexus ratio.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form n° 2065-SD (annual corporation tax return) together with supporting schedules 2058-A through 2059-G (liasse fiscale), transmitted electronically through the EDI-TDFC gateway of impots.gouv.fr or a certified EDI tele-transmission partner.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return for each closed fiscal year; quarterly advance payments are separately reported on form n° 2571-SD.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The liasse fiscale must be filed within three months of the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SAS closing on 31 December, the deadline is 3 May of the following year, extended to 18 May when the return is submitted via the complete EDI e-filing procedure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate name, French SIREN/SIRET registration numbers, code APE (6201Z for computer programming), registered office address and legal-representative details of the SAS.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident SAS must indicate its French permanent-establishment address when attributable business is carried on in France, and must appoint an accredited French tax representative where the company has no EU/EEA establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net annual turnover including recurring SaaS subscriptions, property-management commissions and ancillary platform fees, stated net of French VAT and following mandatory French accrual recognition rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only revenue economically attributable to the French permanent establishment is reported; intercompany SaaS licence fees must be priced at arm's length and evidenced by contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B — Bénéfice ou perte (résultat fiscal)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit or loss after reintegration of non-deductible expenses, application of depreciation and provisions, and reconciliation from accounting income via schedule 2058-A.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The taxable result of a non-resident is computed under the same general rules but is limited to profits and expenses attributable to the French PE in accordance with Article 209 CGI and the applicable double tax treaty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operational tax losses available as a deduction from future taxable profits, with the statutory annual cap equal to 50% of the taxable income exceeding €1,000,000.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses economically attributable to the French permanent establishment are eligible; head-office losses of the foreign parent cannot be set off against French PE profits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Research tax credit computed on qualifying expenditure: staff costs, depreciation of research assets, patent expenses and subcontracting costs related to R&D operations actually carried out in France.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The CIR is claimable only where the qualifying R&D is effectively performed in France through the PE; the credit is recoverable as a refund where it exceeds the CIT due or where the company qualifies as a young SME.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 'Transactions avec des entreprises liées' (statement n° 2257)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Mandatory schedule disclosing transactions with domestic and foreign related enterprises: nature, volume, remuneration and transfer pricing method applied to SaaS licence fees, data licences, royalty flows and management charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident groups must identify the related-party counterparty, the benefit test for the charges, and the arm's length method for each material intercompany transaction, failing which the administration may recharacterize the payments under Article 57 CGI.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or incomplete filing triggers a 10% statutory surcharge on the net CIT due, increased to 40% in cases of bad faith and 80% in cases of fraudulent maneuvering; late-payment interest accumulates at 0.20% per month from the day following the deadline; missing supporting schedules attract fixed fines of €150 each and the administration may proceed to automatic tax assessment where the return is absent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form n° 2571-SD (quarterly corporate income tax instalment notice) filed and paid electronically through EDI-TDFC on the impots.gouv.fr contribution gateway.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly — four advance payments due on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December of each fiscal year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Each instalment is payable by the 15th day of the due month, or the following business day where the 15th falls on a non-business day; the balancing payment is settled together with the annual 2065-SD return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part III — Acompte d'impôt sur les sociétés
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly prepayment equal to 25% of the estimated CIT for the current year, normally referenced to the preceding fiscal year's taxable base and disclosed CIT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident SAS with a French PE pays instalments under its French SIRET from a French euro account; for non-EU/EEA companies the instalment formalities must be performed through the appointed French tax representative.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment of an instalment draws a 5% late-payment surcharge on the unpaid amount plus 0.20% per month of late interest; a 10% correction may also be applied where the instalment base is under-declared by more than 10% of the final CIT liability.
